user.title: Tariff Configuration
user.description: Configure the electricity tariff formula for your provider. The distribution fees here are the fallback used outside any time-of-use band you define next.

data.currency: Display currency code (e.g. EUR, SEK, NOK, DKK, GBP)

tariff_weekday.title: Weekday Tariff Bands (Mon–Fri)
tariff_weekday.description: Optional time-of-use distribution fees for weekdays. Each band's start time (24h HH:MM, local) runs until the next band's start, wrapping past midnight. Leave a band's start blank to skip it; leave all blank to use the flat fees from the previous step.

tariff_weekend.title: Weekend Tariff Bands (Sat/Sun)
tariff_weekend.description: Optional time-of-use distribution fees for weekends. Same rules as the weekday bands. Leave all blank to reuse the flat fees.

inverter.title: Inverter Setup
inverter.description: Select your inverter platform and enter its power ratings. Solis is fully supported. Huawei, SolaX, Sungrow, GoodWe and Deye are wired but untested — verify control on first connect. Fronius, SMA and Kostal are not selectable yet.

inverter_generic.title: Inverter Entity Mapping
inverter_generic.description: If the vendor integration is installed, its inverter is auto-detected (pick which one when several exist). Otherwise map each control + telemetry entity manually. These platforms are untested against hardware: if control doesn't take effect, check Home Assistant logs for the resolver's 'missing roles' warning and confirm the mapped entities.

inverter_entities.title: Inverter Entity Mapping
inverter_entities.description: Map the four entities your inverter integration exposes.

inverter_solis.title: Solis Inverter Setup
inverter_solis.description: If solis_modbus is installed with multiple inverters, select which one sunSale should control. If only one inverter is detected this step is skipped automatically. If solis_modbus is not installed, map the entities manually.

data.inverter_solis_peak_max_usable_grid_powe: Peak-shaving max usable grid power (number, W)

forecast.title: Solar Forecast
forecast.description: Select your solar forecast device(s). Each device's forecast sensors are detected automatically; pick more than one if you have several arrays (e.g. one per roof).

forecast_manual.title: Solar Forecast (manual)
forecast_manual.description: No forecast integration was detected. Map up to two forecast sensor entities manually (Open Meteo, Forecast.Solar, or Solcast).

sources.title: Data Sources
sources.description: Select the electricity price source and entities. Only Nord Pool is validated against a live install; ENTSO-e / Octopus / Amber / TOU are untested — verify the sensor's attributes after setup. Household baseload is derived from inverter telemetry — no dedicated load sensor is required.

data.nordpool_entity: Electricity price sensor (import; leave blank for TOU schedule)
data.price_export_entity: Separate export-price sensor (optional; Octopus Outgoing / Amber feed-in)
data.inverter_entity_solar_energy: Solar energy counter entity (optional, kWh, for chart)
data.inverter_entity_household_consumption_en: Household consumption today-total energy counter (optional, kWh, daily-resetting)
data.bms_battery_soc: Dedicated BMS battery SoC (optional, e.g. JK-BMS)
data.bms_battery_power: Dedicated BMS battery power (optional, signed kW)

price_tou.title: Time-of-use Import Prices
price_tou.description: Define the absolute import price for each time-of-use band (local 24h time). Leave a row's start blank to drop it.

error.invalid_band_time: Band start must be a 24h time like 06:30.
error.invalid_tax_rate: Tax rate must be between 0 and 100.
error.invalid_price: Purchase price must be greater than 0.
error.platform_not_implemented: That inverter platform isn't supported yet. Selectable: Solis, Huawei, SolaX, Sungrow, GoodWe, Deye. (Fronius, SMA, Kostal and SolarEdge are not wired.)
error.invalid_inverter_power: Inverter rated AC power must be greater than 0.
